note: Returns raw bytes (chain hex:encode). CyberChef's Length and Rounds parameters are not supported: the standard GB/T 32905-2016 has one 256-bit output and 64 rounds.
Returns raw bytes (chain hex:encode). CyberChef's Rounds parameter is not supported: only the standard 80 steps exist.

The final ISO/IEC 10118-3 version, raw bytes (chain hex:encode). The Whirlpool-0 and Whirlpool-T variants and the Rounds parameter are not offered: the variants have no citable vectors in the original papers, and Whirlpool-0 has a different, random S-box. Only the standard 10 rounds exist.
Size 128 or 256 and Rounds 2, 4 or 8, as in CyberChef. Raw bytes (chain hex:encode). Implemented from Merkle's Xerox reference distribution 2.5a, whose S-boxes it uses.

GOST R 34.11-94 is gost:digest with an sbox parameter: test (RFC 5831) or cryptopro (RFC 4357). GOST R 34.11-2012 is the separate streebog:digest. Only the test and CryptoPro S-box sets are offered. Raw bytes (chain hex:encode).
Size 256 or 512, as in CyberChef. Raw bytes (chain hex:encode), in the byte order of the RFC 6986 examples reversed (little-endian), which is the conventional digest string.
